Mac Allister Expresses Sadness Over Liverpool Contract Situation

Liverpool midfielder Alexis Mac Allister has stated that he is 'very, very sad' about the club's contract situation with him. He indicated that he could have left the club in the summer. Mac Allister's comments suggest he is questioning Liverpool's approach to his contract negotiations.
